name: Thaumaturgy (Neptune's Might) — 1 Basic — Eyes of the Sea

system.description: Staring into a body of standing water lets you view events that transpired in, on, or around it, up to one day into the past. To see further back, make Simple Tests, each success extending your view further, or spend a Willpower Trait for an automatic success. This power only functions with standing water such as lakes or puddles, not oceans, rivers, or running water.
